author: G.R.Gray, 1860
summary: 봄과 가을에 한반도를 지나가는 드물지 않은 나그네새로, 숲속에서 지낸다. 주로 곤충을 먹으며 딱정벌레와 매미를 즐겨 잡는다. 강가나 하구의 버드나무와 작은 관목이 흩어진 초지에 둥지를 틀고 6월 상순~7월 하순에 한배에 3~5개의 알을 낳는다. 구북구 동부, 시베리아 남동부, 만주 북부 등지에서 번식하고 필리핀과 뉴기니 등에서 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Gray's Grasshopper Warbler (Locustella fasciolata), adult, as seen in Korean forest undergrowth during passage in May-June and August-September: upperparts plain dark olive-brown, unstreaked; a greyish-white supercilium and dark eye-stripe; face and neck sides greyish; chin and upper throat whitish; lower throat and breast grey; belly white; flanks and long undertail coverts greyish-buff to warm buff-brown; wings and long rounded tail dark brown; bill fairly stout, dark above and pinkish below; dark eye; strong pinkish-brown legs.
art.pose: perched low in forest undergrowth, side view
art.scene: Korean forest interior with undergrowth during spring or autumn migration; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched low in undergrowth: plain dark olive-brown upperparts, greyish-white supercilium, grey breast, white belly, greyish-buff flanks and undertail, long broad rounded tail, pinkish legs
adult, front view: whitish chin, grey lower throat and breast contrasting with the white belly, greyish-buff flanks
art.build: Large, bulky Locustella warbler, about 17cm, larger and heavier than a sparrow, about the size of an Oriental Reed Warbler but rounder, with a heavy chest and flattish head. Bill stout, shorter than the head. Legs long and strong, pinkish-brown. Wings short and rounded; the long, broad, graduated tail extends well beyond the wingtips. Skulks on or near the ground in dense undergrowth, walking or hopping with the tail slightly cocked.
avoid: Do not paint streaks on the back or spots on the breast.
Do not paint a short or square tail; it is long, broad and rounded.
Do not paint a crisp white supercilium with a dark border or a pale buff body like an Acrocephalus reed warbler.
